headline: Singapore's STT GDC Eyes $3.1 Billion Loan Amid AI Debt Binge
summary: Singapore-based STT GDC is seeking a $3.1 billion loan, adding to a wider wave of debt financing driven by the artificial intelligence boom.
why: Massive capital expenditure in data infrastructure requires significant debt financing, reflecting how the artificial intelligence boom drives leverage across the technology sector.

impacts.name: Technology Infrastructure
impacts.why: Large debt-fueled expansions support long-term sector growth but increase leverage risks.
